notes: Entertainment's genre notes name dance institutions outright as the same build as a concert or talent show, so this is venue-stage and the Performance Venue preset rather than the Indoor Venue reading of one building - the stage is what the place is for, and orientation toward it is the design. Kept social-hub for the studio floor where dancers gather and spawn-first-reveal for the entrance shot, and added backstage-support for the costume section, which is the option that covers a performer-only changing area and is what puts this on P3; I dropped the preset's spectator-bleachers because the answers describe a small stage in an academy with no judges and no audience seating, and raked tiers would add elevation nobody asked for. Decided without a user: the whole map is the interior of one bright modern academy per the answers, so no exterior is generated and the only inside transition is the costume room. Playing music and tmod are an audio system and an admin tool with no layout geometry, and the requested title is naming rather than build; costume wardrobes are avatar cosmetics, so I did not name Roleplay & Avatar Sim as a second genre.
